name: selfbuilt_yuv420_dcvc_rt_protocol
dataset: frozen selfbuilt test only; no PKU
reference: native decoded 8-bit YUV420 code values; no range remap; no RGB roundtrip; frozen local/server SHA256 identical

traditional.structure: unmodified official lowdelay B, past references only, hierarchical QP, 10-bit internal
traditional.qp_source: four anchor QPs retained from frozen test manifest; RT supplement leaves QP as parameter

rt.source: official yuv420 reader; nearest chroma upsample; average-pool chroma downsample
rt.metric: official float reconstruction, clamped *255 without rounding

tcm.lambda_policy: no lambda override at test time; original quality checkpoints determine operating points
tcm.input_adapter: shared native420 -> official RT nearest444 -> official RT BT709 full-code-range RGB -> round/clamp RGB8 -> original TCM input; in-memory RGB8 equals PNG RGB8
tcm.output_adapter: original float reconstruction -> official RT BT709 full-range YCbCr -> 2x2 mean UV -> clamp *255, no output rounding
tcm.note: TCM official entry point is RGB PNG only; this explicit adapter implements common YUV420 evaluation and includes conversion error

metrics.psnr: per-plane official RT calc_psnr; weighted plane PSNR=(6Y+U+V)/8
metrics.aggregation: mean frames -> mean 3 windows per video -> equal mean 82 videos
metrics.bitstreams: actual bitstreams with headers; independent fresh decoder on all pilots; traditional decoder on every result

user_exceptions: 96 frames and IP32 replace paper all-frames/IP-1; no claim of exact reproduction of published BD-rate
storage: all outputs/cache/temp under D: or @DATASET_ROOT@; original code/env/models/data read-only
